assumptions: Shot durations are unspecified; use 10, 6, and 14 seconds to allow natural movement and the required pre-pickup cup reveal.
Woman is an adult about 35, with shoulder-length brown hair, grey open cardigan over a cream shirt, blue jeans and brown flat shoes; no accessories or carried props.

The room has cream walls, oak floor, a beige sofa on the south side of a rectangular wooden tea table, and a white glazed outward-opening garden door in the east wall. Garden is a simple lawn bounded by a hedge.

World coordinates: table center is (0,0), east is +x, north away from sofa is +y. Position A=(0.28,0.12) and B=(0.48,0.30) on the table. Shot 1 tall=A, short=B; shot 3 tall=B, short=A. Under a north-side view looking south, B is nearer and screen-left of A.

The two white porcelain blue-floral teacups have one handle each, no saucers or spoons; tall cup is 11 cm high and short cup 7 cm. Both have recognizable cobalt flower-and-leaf decoration. Tea is dark amber-black without milk.

The garden doorway begins closed so she can push it open; it then remains open. The return shot uses an elevated north-side three-quarter angle that includes the east doorway and reveals both cup interiors.

Built-in background output measures 1672x941, approximately 16:9; use this actual native landscape size consistently for scene frames. Preserve accepted incidental room decor: fireplace, television cabinet, curtains, rug, plants and shelving as fixed set dressing. Door is the active leaf of the white glazed double doorway.
Shot 1 ends on the exterior paved threshold immediately before the lawn; woman continues onto grass in shot 2.

Handedness is not specified by source. Final drinking endpoint uses the visible near hand in rear three-quarter profile; free hand is occluded. Video prompt leaves handedness unconstrained. Newly exposed south wall has a tripod lamp and plant; these remain fixed in shot 3.

Actual accepted library dimensions are recorded per image; the tool chose 1672x941 backgrounds, 1024x1536 character, and 1254x1254 object images. All six scene frames use native 1672x941. No image size repair or crop was applied to canonical PNGs.
